geometry_authority.cad_role: authoritative for the existing manufactured mirror geometry and its installed pose once the top-level transform chain is qualified; never a source of electrostatic voltages

constraints.mirror_five_electrode_envelope: use CAD dimensions as a manufacturing envelope
constraints.dual_stripe_curve_scale: exact native B-spline parameters are a theory-CAD realization; active solver curves must be evaluated from those parameters, never from sampled boundary coordinates
constraints.prism_scale: use CAD triangle dimensions as a mechanical constraint
constraints.accelerator_baseline: Astral accelerator is retained only as a nonfocusing mechanical evidence record; the Candidate accelerator is theory-derived

theory_parameter_authority.invariant_structure: The governing equations, variable dependencies, polynomial orders, and linear-versus-higher-order Stripe decomposition are fixed by the paper theory.
theory_parameter_authority.rule: Paper numerical examples are regression references only. Every active numerical value must be an explicit baseline input or a derived output of the current geometry and declared constraints; equality to a printed paper value is never an implicit acceptance condition.

coordinate_system.origin: x=0 transverse symmetry plane, y=0 registered mathematical origin of both manufactured Stripe functions, and z=0 central mirror plane
coordinate_system.y_positive: increasing argument of the manufactured S_i(y) functions toward the slow turning point; identical to the paper's positive slow-drift direction
coordinate_system.z_positive: fast reflection direction; central mirror plane is z=0

simion_workbench_from_project.semantics: GEM locate(-PA_origin) followed by an unrotated unit-scale IOB instance at PA_origin makes Workbench x/y/z numerically identical to project x/y/z. PA-local grid coordinates are not project coordinates.

accelerator_energy_contract.semantics: The accelerator operating-point centre may be selected within 4000 +/- 500 eV/q; 4000 eV/q is the current reference centre, not an exact global solution constraint. Within one selected operating point, the first design envelope limits particle net-gain deviation to +/-100 eV/q; the actual finite-source interval must later be calculated and may be asymmetric. Mirror and Stripe axial theory use the net gain only, so their current w0 is 4000 eV/q. The separately reported post-acceleration total-energy centre is pre-acceleration kinetic energy plus net gain, currently 4005 eV/q.

mirror.manufacturing_constraint: The existing five-electrode mirror geometry is already manufactured and is fixed for this Candidate.  Theory may optimize only mirror voltages and the operating point.  Axial geometry optimization is reserved for a separately identified future redesign.

l0_acceptance_budget.semantics: User-selected preliminary allocation: the mirror receives the full relative time-width budget for R>=50000. The L0 local slope tolerance is derived as mirror_time_width_fraction/(2*minimum_mass_resolution*half_energy_window_v), where the three mirror nodes are derived from the net-gain reference centre and maximum particle net-gain deviation. This is a preliminary mirror-only gate; later full-analyser budgeting must allocate nonzero error to source, Stripe, prism and numerical terms.

global_l0_search_profile.semantics: First full-envelope L0 campaign. The runner uses min(available logical processors, maximum_parallel_workers, restart_count) independent processes; each restart samples the complete declared B--E envelope, then applies local least-squares refinement. Each worker inherits one-thread numerical-library limits to prevent process/thread oversubscription. All numerical controls are frozen in this profile and echoed in every receipt. A candidate still requires derivative-step convergence and separate L1 selection.

l1_screen_profile.semantics: Numerical L1 screening profile for the complete L0-accepted family. Every stable seed is independently refined against the three mirror-only L0 slopes plus the L1 gamma selector, and distinct converged roots are retained rather than collapsing to the closest initial bracket. The deduplication tolerance is only a numerical root-identity threshold. The finite-difference probes are not physical beam widths; the active base and two larger scales must satisfy the declared adjacent gamma and Tbar convergence gates. Peak-field and three-dimensional validation remain separate.

exact_k_operating_point_selection.semantics: For every trial accelerator net-gain centre, solve the three mirror-only L0 slope equations and select gamma=90 degrees on that mirror family. T_0 and W are strictly the bare-mirror quantities with both Stripe biases zero. T_D(theta_0)/T_0-K=0 is only the paper-normalized adiabatic selector over that family: it is not a fourth axial mirror equation and is not the actual fast-phase count after the finite Stripe biases are enabled. The complete analyser must separately integrate the y-dependent local period T_z(E,y)=T_0(E)+partial_E DeltaJ_stripe(E,y), require the same mirror-turn phase on return, and verify the discrete turn sequence in SIMION. Root and finite-difference tolerances are float64 numerical controls, not physical performance thresholds.

theory_requirements.optimization_scope: mirror voltages and operating point only; a future redesign may separately optimize axial geometry
theory_requirements.analytic_model_status: Berdnikov ideal-boundary assumption selected by user: H=15 mm from the 30-mm beam channel.  The inner 4-mm-slot end plate is grounded; the closed outer E cover is not a grounded boundary.  B--E voltages are independent theory variables with no imposed monotonic order.  Real 3-D field validation remains required before accepting an L0/L1 voltage result

E.retention_semantics: The shared closed E cover is at U_E.  Its lower numerical bound is derived at runtime as the next representable value above the maximum declared mirror energy; no sign or monotonic order is imposed on B--E.

voltage_envelope_v.initialization_semantics: The numerical start vector is derived from this envelope and the energy contract only. B--D may not exceed the derived minimum particle net acceleration gain; E alone may exceed it and must remain above the highest derived mirror energy node. No historical or manually supplied voltage vector is an active input.

mirror.centre_y_evidence: cad_to_theory_frame v2 maps project y=CAD_X+158 mm; the CAD mirror local long-axis centre CAD_X=0 maps to project y=158 mm.

beam_slot.role: 30-mm-wide longitudinal aperture in each of the five active mirror electrodes; it terminates 10 mm before each y end and must not be extended through the two grounded end plates in z
beam_slot.evidence: read-only SolidWorks STL cross-section: every active A--E plate has local long-axis slot endpoints x=10 and 590 mm and transverse edges y=50 and 80 mm; under cad_to_theory_frame this is a centred 580 x 30 mm project (y,x) slot, not a y-through slot

grounded_inner_shield.role: Stripe-facing grounded shield plate; its narrow slot is the only opening on the inner mirror end face
grounded_inner_shield.cad_evidence: 反射电极装配-电极A 盖板: 600 x 125 x 5 mm body, central approximately 580 x 4 mm longitudinal slot

outer_e_closure.role: closed outer cover electrically belonging to E; no beam slot; its voltage is the independently optimized E voltage
outer_e_closure.cad_evidence: 反射电极装配-电极E 盖板: 600 x 120 x 5 mm body, no central beam slot; user-confirmed non-ground outer electrode

mirror.cad_pose_evidence: 20260902__two-mirror-pose-audit/composed_top_level_cad_pose.json: inner A-cover centres are project z=+104.5 and -104.5 mm, so each 5-mm shield begins at |z|=102 mm; active A/B/C/D/E begin at |z|=107/167/229/261/291 mm.
mirror.axial_coordinates: derived by mirror_geometry_parameters.derive_mirror_boundaries; mechanical starts use inner shield, active thicknesses and gaps, while theoretical grounded A begins at central z=0 and B/C/D/E steps use physical gap centres; never hand-entered
mirror.seed_status: CAD geometry evidence only; no mirror voltage is known or authorized before theory optimization

geometry_review_visualization.semantics: These values only color-separate the two PA basis groups in the already reviewed geometry IOB. Theory, optimization, trajectory, and Candidate materialization must never read them as an initial or operating point.

central_ground_profile.parameter_provenance: 20260902__two-mirror-pose-audit/ion_foil_body_bspline_project_frame.json; composed top-level CAD body edges 19/20/21/23 of Ion-Foil-2

terminal_profile.cad_features: Ion-Foil-2 native Sketch20 cubic extension maps to project y=0..4, Sketch22 terminal trims at z=+-34.8714135336 map to project y=-2..0; x-through terminal window is project y=-2..4,z=-22..22. No spline extrapolation or full-z bridge.

beam_slot_y_bridges_mm.cad_evidence: 20260903 read-only Ion-Foil STL section: the 4-mm central opening has local-longitudinal endpoints at 5 and 390 mm within the 392-mm foil body. Under cad_to_theory_frame, these become project-y bridges of 5 mm at y_min and 2 mm at y_max; it is not a y-through cut.

theory_profile.parameter_provenance: read-only SolidWorks native B-spline knot/control parameters from 20260902__ion-foil-recovery/stripe_long_bspline_profiles.json; the solver geometry evaluates these parameters and never interpolates the former sampled CAD boundary table
theory_profile.component_interpretation: The user-confirmed manufactured design used L=340 mm and the two original theory geometry bases: set_1 is a scaled high-order psi_s curve and set_2 is a scaled linear psi_m curve. Their fitted CAD coefficients recover the two geometry scales; the exact finite-bias hard-boundary action relation then gives the nominal v1/v2 pair analytically. Those values initialize, but do not freeze, later finite-three-dimensional voltage calibration.

path_length_mapping.semantics: For this manufactured instance the frozen upper-minus-lower profile is the theoretical total path length S_i(y), not an independently additive per-solid width. The two mirrored physical electrodes share one theoretical response. This explicit factor prevents a hidden factor-of-two convention and remains subject to direct three-dimensional centre-ion action/path verification before performance claims.

cad_body_topology_identity.features: Native solid/sketch end topology after the unified v2 transform: all bodies project y=-2..390; central x=+-2 cut project y=0..385. Foil-1 Sketch14 and Foil-3 Sketch12 terminal trims; Foil-2 Sketch20/22/25 short cubic and split terminal region.
cad_body_topology_identity.simplification: Long B-splines retain their existing native parameter contracts; selected end planes use the composed CAD frame. Fasteners/holes not defining the beam channel remain outside the field-critical reconstruction.

dual_stripe_l0.manufactured_design_drift_length_semanti: Frozen input for the current already-designed and manufactured geometry only. It is not a universal dual-Stripe theory constant and remains free or derived in a future newly designed hardware line. The value must fit the active Stripe span at every declared eta node.

fixed_cad_shape_identification.coefficient_semantics: Fit the current manufactured curves in physical distance from y=0 and transform them with the frozen manufactured L=340 mm. The user confirms that these curves were generated as scaled copies of the original high-order psi_s and linear psi_m theory bases. Project the fitted coefficients onto those two declared bases to recover both geometry scales; do not treat the CAD millimetre coefficients themselves as voltages.
fixed_cad_shape_identification.fit_semantics: Use the native frozen B-splines over their complete active span, subtract each y=0 baseline, and fit the declared physical-coordinate structures by linear least squares. Report raw coefficients, residuals and sampling convergence without inventing an unapproved CAD-fit tolerance. L is supplied by the manufactured-design contract, not inferred from the fit.

coordinate_mapping.semantics: The paper function argument and project/SIMION y share both origin and positive direction. The origin is registered from the manufactured theory basis, not inferred from either endpoint of the finite mechanical curve. L is the positive physical design length.

dual_stripe_l0.coordinate_definition: eta=y/L with positive L and eta_turning=1, where theory y, project y and SIMION Workbench y are numerically identical. Thus y=0,340,390 mm map directly to eta=0,1,390/340. The common zero is the zero argument of both manufactured S_i(y) functions. A finite CAD curve may start or end at a nonzero function argument, so no mechanical endpoint is allowed to define this origin. The adiabatic reduction averages over fast z phase and therefore does not assign a mirror-turn z coordinate to eta=0.

theory_function_coordinate_registration.authority: native manufactured B-spline geometry registered against the declared no-constant fifth-order psi_s basis and linear psi_m basis at L=340 mm
theory_function_coordinate_registration.method: Choose the affine y registration that preserves the declared theory-function coefficients; never choose the origin merely because a sampled curve or solid body begins or ends there.
theory_function_coordinate_registration.current_mechanical_coincidence: In the present manufactured assembly the registered function zero is co-located with the low-y boundary of the active long B-spline. The whole solid begins at y=-2 mm, so neither the physical-body endpoint nor a trajectory crossing defines the function origin.
theory_function_coordinate_registration.exclusion_semantics: The complete physical cross-section can be described piecewise on y=[-2,390] mm, but the CAD terminal/trim interval y=[-2,0] mm is not generated by the active polynomial/B-spline response. The theory response S_i(y)-S_i(0) and all eta integrals use the registered active domain beginning at y=0.

origin_discrimination_evidence.comparison: Translate the fitted fifth-order set-1 polynomial to each hypothesized function zero, transform with L=340 mm, and compare its coefficient direction with the published high-order theory basis after optimizing one common scale.
origin_discrimination_evidence.candidate_origins: derive the lower bounds from active_theory_curve_domain_project_y_mm and whole_physical_body_domain_project_y_mm
origin_discrimination_evidence.interpretation: Select the lower coefficient-direction residual only as coordinate evidence. The computed residuals are diagnostic outputs, not baseline inputs or solver PASS tolerances.

dual_stripe_l0.axial_width_W_parameterization: The mirror-only L0/L1 solution independently determines its axial period and the corresponding mirror W from fixed mirror geometry and mirror theory. Stripe theory consumes that receipt as an input; it does not feed a Stripe action, K target, or Stripe voltage back into the mirror-voltage solve. The complete analyser time is evaluated downstream, but mirror W is never a second independently fitted number.

time_platform_constraint.semantics: Four user-specified time-platform derivative nodes symmetric around the nominal turning point. The paper does not publish its four node locations; this project value is user authority, not an attribution to the original paper. Before activation, each physical y=entry_y+eta_turn*L must lie within both frozen Stripe active spans and the downstream-problem Jacobian rank gate must classify that problem.

dimensionless_paper_target.published_reference_semantics: Rounded values from the cited Astral paper are a continuation seed and branch-selection reference only. The active target coefficients are regenerated from psi(1)=1, kappa-prime(1)=0, and the four project-owned tau-g derivative nodes; no printed coefficient is copied into hardware geometry or voltage.
dimensionless_paper_target.random_seed_semantics: Derive the reproducible generator seed from SHA-256 of the printed branch reference and the project eta nodes; do not store an arbitrary mutable seed.
dimensionless_paper_target.selection_rule: Among roots passing the six-condition residual gate, choose minimum coefficient-scaled distance from the published rounded branch, then minimum residual norm. Preserve other distinct roots as diagnostics.

operating_seed_search.voltage_envelope_semantics: The diagnostic search interval is derived as [-nominal_energy, nextafter(minimum_mirror_energy,-infinity)] V. It is a finite numerical audit envelope, not a hardware rating or proof that no roots exist outside it.
operating_seed_search.turning_search_sampling_semantics: The search sample count is derived as the maximum native nonzero B-spline span count times dual_stripe.theory_profile.sampling_per_nonzero_knot_span times this multiplier; no absolute count is stored independently.
operating_seed_search.complete_consistency_refinement_start_se: At the frozen manufactured-design L, evaluate the complete native residual vector on the Cartesian product of both voltage fractions. Retain the minimum-norm point as an anchor, then choose the remaining refinement starts by deterministic farthest-point sampling in normalized (v1,v2) coordinates from the top-ranked pool whose size is refinement_start_count times complete_consistency_diversity_pool_multiplier. L is never a numerical start or fit coordinate. The refinement count and pool multiplier are frozen resource-control choices, not physical conditions or paper values.
operating_seed_search.complete_consistency_parallel_semantics: Qualified mirror roots are independent search units. Use at most two single-thread numerical workers, currently matching the two-root family, rather than hidden multithreaded BLAS inside one root search.
operating_seed_search.residual_tolerance_semantics: The first tolerance closes the dimensionless K relation. The second is a numerical root tolerance for the central-difference kappa-prime residual, selected above the observed native B-spline/integral differencing floor; neither value changes the governing paper equation or acts as a physical performance threshold.
operating_seed_search.selection_rule: After native-B-spline refinement, reject zero/singular and effectively single-Stripe roots. Both bias magnitudes must exceed the absolute numerical floor and their scale-free minimum/maximum magnitude ratio must meet minimum_bias_magnitude_ratio. Choose the surviving root with minimum maximum absolute bias, then minimum response-matrix condition number.
operating_seed_search.qualification_limit: This closes only a two-equation analytic seed. Time-platform, full-energy, P1/P2, and three-dimensional residuals are reported or left pending and cannot be promoted without their own user-authorized tolerances and rank gate.

dual_stripe_l0.determination_gate: Before publishing any solved voltage, L, W, kappa, theta, or prism entrance state, scale the actual Jacobian for its owning mirror-only or downstream Stripe/P1/P2 problem with contract-owned parameter and residual scales and evaluate its SVD. Report rank, nullity, redundant-constraint count, condition number, and the scaled residual component in the left null space. Rank below the physical unknown count is underdetermined; a square full-rank compatible system is square_exact; a full-column-rank redundant system is overdetermined_consistent only when its irreducible residual meets the declared tolerance; otherwise it is locally_incompatible.

determination_numerics.scale_authority: Every production solve must list one positive physical parameter scale and one positive residual scale for each named coordinate. These two dimensionless SVD tolerances are numerical classification controls, not physical acceptance tolerances and not paper values.

complete_consistency_residual_acceptance.semantics: The six fixed-hardware drift equalities require separately authorized physical or numerical acceptance tolerances before a Stripe operating state can be published. Optimizer scaling and the SVD compatibility tolerance are not substitutes. When activated, this mapping must contain exactly one positive absolute tolerance for K, kappa-prime, and the four time-platform residual names; missing or extra names fail closed. The three full-analyser energy slopes belong to downstream TE1/TE2 calibration and are not Stripe acceptance residuals.

voltage_initialization.semantics: Every nominal voltage is derived anew from this frozen geometry and its owning theory; a human-entered or historical voltage vector is not an admissible initial vector. Mirror B--E come from the independent mirror-theory feasible family and mirror.theory_requirements.voltage_envelope_v is their sole voltage envelope. For each accepted mirror W, the fitted set-1/set-2 CAD coefficients, user-confirmed original psi_s/psi_m basis identity, L=340 mm, K and w0 give v1/v2 through the exact finite-bias geometry-scale inverse. Both Stripe voltages remain adjustable in the subsequent finite-three-dimensional calibration. P1/P2 then consume the derived Stripe entrance state.
derivation_chain: Berdnikov fixed-geometry mirror L0/L1 continuation independently constructs and ranks the B--E feasible family using only mirror geometry and mirror-theory conditions

the exact two-Stripe action/response equations consume the accepted mirror period/W receipt and analytically invert the two manufactured theory-basis geometry scales into the nominal v1/v2 pair and y=0 entrance state
the path-ordered hard-boundary P1/P2 construction derives the two prism seed voltages from source/focus, physical prism hand-off geometry, and that derived Stripe entrance state
finite three-dimensional shooting independently validates/corrects the downstream Stripe/P1/P2 transport without retroactively fitting mirror voltage to Stripe theory

mirror_family_selection.semantics: The fixed-geometry axial mirror theory declares exactly three energy-local normalized period-slope equalities for four B--E voltages. Its three-row Jacobian therefore identifies an L0 family rather than a falsely unique vector. gamma=90 degrees, transverse stability, and phase-averaged transverse time aberration are L1 mirror-theory screening/selection criteria; they are not silently promoted into an axial fourth equality, and no Stripe quantity is introduced solely to force uniqueness.
mirror_family_selection.tie_semantics: If candidates remain indistinguishable at the declared numerical resolution, retain all of them as a mirror-family receipt rather than fabricating a unique voltage vector.

current_fixed_hardware_l0_l1_problem.determination_semantics: The frozen mirror geometry and the three axial energy conditions define a four-voltage mirror-only L0 family. Its three-row Jacobian and feasibility checks must be published with that family; an L1 mirror-only selection receipt identifies any representative member and its transverse diagnostics without inventing a fourth axial residual. Each qualified mirror root is then tested against the fixed-hardware Stripe drift problem with only the two Stripe biases as solve coordinates; L=340 mm is a frozen input of this manufactured design. Normalizing the pseudopotential at the physical slow turn makes psi(1)=1 an identity; target K, kappa-prime, and four time-platform residuals form the six-condition overdetermined drift-consistency test. The three full-analyser local energy slopes are still evaluated with the Stripe baseline action retained, but they are downstream global-calibration diagnostics owned by a newly derived mirror TE1/TE2 Jacobian, not extra equations assigned to v1 or v2. The injection angle and drift/fast energy partition are derived from the same slow-turn energy balance. P1/P2 voltages belong to the subsequent finite-field transport problem and are not allowed to make the Stripe drift conditions appear solvable. Mirror gamma remains an upstream receipt gate and is never repeated downstream. The two P1/P2 voltage residuals are the first post-P2 positive-z mirror-turn y coordinate and the slow kinetic energy. The preceding negative-mirror pre-reflection, P2 passage, positive-side Stripe traversal, and the turn z coordinate are full-three-dimensional diagnostics, not extra voltage equations supplied by the adiabatic y model. Each owning problem separately uses its contract-scaled Jacobian SVD and left-null residual to distinguish underdetermined, square_exact, overdetermined_consistent, and locally_incompatible states.

derived_fields_only_after_owning_problem.drift_length_L_mm: frozen manufactured-design input, currently 340 mm; future newly designed hardware may instead declare or derive another L
derived_fields_only_after_owning_problem.nominal_drift_kinetic_energy_per_charge_: fixed by prism_transport.energy_partition.drift_kinetic_energy_ev for the nominal source centre
derived_fields_only_after_owning_problem.nominal_fast_reflection_energy_per_charg: fixed by prism_transport.energy_partition.fast_reflection_kinetic_energy_ev and equal to nominal.energy_per_charge_v

prisms.parameter_provenance: 20260903 read-only Ion-Foil/prism/grounded STL section audit. Coordinates are project-frame Candidate inputs derived from the qualified top-level rigid-transform chain, never GEM literals.

ground_shields.cad_evidence: Top-level composed CAD pose under the unified v2 frame: grounded-1 is one continuous body x=[-24,12], y=[-77,-33], z=[-100,-30] mm. Its local x=[-20,20] channel maps to project y=[-75,-35] mm, so the two 2-mm end lands at y=[-77,-75] and [-35,-33] are retained automatically by subtracting this finite rectangular slot from the one body; no bridge solids are added.

cad_body_topology_identity.source_features: grounded native Sketch3 triangular aperture, Sketch10 rear stepped section, faces 1/5/6/7/8/9 and 10/11 finite-x slot

cross_aperture.cad_measurement: user measurement 2026-09-03 transformed into the unified v2 frame: 4-mm x width, 80-mm z opening with 57-mm end lands, 22-mm y opening; from the far Stripe side y=-32, leave 4 mm then open y=-28..-6, leaving 3 mm to the effective Stripe-side y=-3 frame edge.

cad_body_topology_identity.source_features: grounded 2 native face topology and part sketches after the v2 transform: main body y=-32..-3, local stripe-side extension only |z|<=21, backing only 57<=|z|<=97; orthogonal rectangular slot union and exact triangle

prism_transport.scope: The first prism diagnostic receives a static hard-boundary scale seed only. It is not the two-prism injection solution. The manufactured path is P1=16, a negative-mirror pre-reflection, then P2=17 and the positive-side Stripe region; finite 3-D shooting must replace the direct-ray diagnostic before a transport or resolution claim.

energy_partition.derivation: The source starts with 5 eV in the drift direction and the orthogonal accelerator adds a nominal 4000 eV in the fast reflection direction. The mirror and finite-bias Stripe axial action use 4000 eV; the direction vector is normalized with the 4005 eV total.
energy_partition.candidate_operating_partition: fixed nominal input for analytic initialization; measured or simulated source spread is added later without replacing this centre

entry_reference.semantics: two-zone first-time-focus plane transported toward the accelerator-exit prism

target_interface.semantics: interface/acceptance plane in the 1-mm mechanical gap before the negative inner mirror face; it constrains direction and aperture, not an unproven single y coordinate

second_prism.required_input: geometry-constrained source/focus -> P1 -> negative-mirror pre-reflection -> P2 -> positive-side Stripe traversal -> positive-mirror-turn drift-origin contract; P2 is not a K=25-return device

drift_phase_origin_authority.fast_velocity_condition: v_z=0 with outward positive-z motion reversing toward negative z
drift_phase_origin_authority.slow_velocity_condition: v_y>0 with drift kinetic energy derived from the compatible Mirror-Stripe solution
drift_phase_origin_authority.return_phase_condition: after the complete slow-drift excursion, return to the same positive-z mirror-turn phase at y=0 with v_y<0

two_prism_injection_l0.semantics: CAD triangles and shields constrain mechanical clearance only. The accelerator-focus ray is frozen input. In the fixed manufactured topology P2 is exited along positive project z and the ray must traverse the positive-z physical Stripe bands before the slow-drift phase origin; therefore a y=0 P2-exit or Stripe-edge event is forbidden as a substitute. The two voltage-sensitive targets are the first post-P2 positive-z mirror-turn y coordinate and the slow kinetic energy supplied by the compatible Mirror-Stripe solution. At that actual Stripe-on turn, v_z=0 follows from event localization and z is a full-field trajectory result; the bare-mirror turning coordinate is only an analytic seed/diagnostic and is never imposed as a third target. Finite three-dimensional P1/P2 shooting must still demonstrate a compatible full-column-rank scaled Jacobian.

stage_2_rings.purpose: five physical acceleration rings in the long second extraction region; frame aperture, centers, spacing, and voltages are all derived from the declared accelerator contract

local_pa_numerical_profile.purpose: independently refined grounded-enclosure accelerator PA; user-selected x/y/z mesh 0.25/0.25/0.1 mm resolves each 1-mm axial ring thickness with ten cells and aligns both ideal-grid planes. Mesh refinement alone does not establish timing, focal-plane, or resolution convergence.

accelerator.shape_semantics: open frame with 40-mm x outer width and 36-mm y outer height, two node-aligned ideal grids, and a 48-mm x by 44-mm y finite-wall grounded shield cavity. The asymmetric physical envelope is derived from the fixed accelerator-exit prism centreline and the CAD grounded-2 y boundary: it retains at least the declared positive y clearance instead of intersecting the long central prism shield. The exit grid spans to and contacts the inner edge of the grounded enclosure. The repeller has the declared 2-mm lateral clearance and a separate declared rear acceleration gap before the grounded rear cap; it never touches the shield shell. The exit faces project -z; its analytically derived first time-focus plane is z=0 at the declared nonzero y injection coordinate, and the accelerator body extends toward +z. The lateral enclosure is deliberately reduced from the rejected 60/72-mm provisional box; it remains a theory-derived Candidate, not a CAD-copy claim.

detector.semantics: Detector is a distinct PA instance, not an analyser-PA marker. Its active face normal is project +z and its +z face remains exactly the declared clearance before the positive grounded-mirror inner face. Its y placement is derived to retain the declared clearance from the central-prism grounded shield; it must not intersect that shield, the accelerator enclosure, or the grounded mirror.

mirror_internal_diagnostic.semantics: A direct analyser release retained only to isolate mirror and Stripe dynamics from the accelerator and P1/P2. It must not be consumed by a complete-instrument flight, transmission, detector-TOF, or resolution workflow.

accelerator_focus_diagnostic.position_authority: accelerator release_position_in_gap_1_mm and derived reviewed placement

required_inputs: a mirror-theory-qualified root satisfying the paper-normalized adiabatic T_D(theta_0)/T_0 target
a complete-analyser fast-phase integral using the y-dependent Stripe-on local period and returning to the same positive mirror-turn phase
a full-rank compatible P1/P2 finite-three-dimensional transport solution
the resulting first-negative-mirror-turn state at registered function y=0 after the mandatory pre-origin Stripe traversal

particle_source.initial_spread_status: source-profile-specific ideal diagnostics; the complete MR-TOF center and its spread are not yet published

center_screening.purpose: single-center topology and voltage screening; not a timing-convergence result

center_refined.purpose: single-center event-order and fractional-K refinement at fixed mesh

center_precision.purpose: single-center fractional-K numerical floor check at fixed mesh

simion.full_path_timeout_semantics: derived as this factor times target_K times the 4*terminal-plane axial round-trip path divided by the frozen nominal 4-keV ion speed; it is an explicit loss/diagnostic bound, never a performance threshold

geometry_review_isotropic.purpose: SIMION GUI geometry and voltage review only. The 33.6-mm two-zone gap cannot be exactly node-aligned at 2 mm/gu, so each ideal-grid plane is quantized by at most 1 mm and the run manifest records the actual raw-row locations. It must never be used for field convergence, timing, flight, or resolution.

analyzer_global_baseline.purpose: current full-envelope analyser mesh; it may define a fixed-grid centre reference only and is not a spatial-convergence result

mirror_turn.reuse_rule: build positive-z and negative-z mirror families independently because asymmetric prism boundary responses prohibit whole-field z-reflection reuse

stripe_mirror_bridge.reuse_rule: build positive-z and negative-z bridge families independently because off-axis prism geometry breaks whole-analyzer z-reflection reuse

analyzer_spatial_convergence.boundary_rule: for every independently adjustable voltage basis, interpolate the verified global PA basis onto all six local-patch faces as Dirichlet electrode nodes before local Refine; never add independently solved coarse and fine electrostatic fields
analyzer_spatial_convergence.workbench_rule: the local patch instance has higher priority than the global analyser only inside the patch; no blending or unrecorded instance jump is allowed
analyzer_spatial_convergence.continuity_gate: sample every patch-face node before flight and fail closed unless both potential and normal-field mismatch converge across the three declared local mesh scales
analyzer_spatial_convergence.retuning_rule: re-solve the centre voltage root independently at each accepted spatial mesh; a voltage root from another mesh is only an initial seed
